'''Idiyappam''' (rice noodles) is a South Indian food, usually served for breakfast.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] raw (i.e. not roasted) [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|rice flour]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]] (hot water preferred by some)
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Ghee|ghee]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste 
 
== Procedure ==
# Mix rice flour with hot water and salt.
# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] it into a smooth [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. 
# Press the dough through an idiyappam presser or sieve onto banana leaves on which a little grated coconut has been sprinkled. Alternatively, press it directly onto an [[Cookbook:Idli Pan|idli pan]] without banana leaves.
# [[Cookbook:Steaming|Steam]] for 5–10 minutes. Some people add a little grated coconut on top before steaming.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Idiyappams may be served with egg curry or brown chickpea (kadala) curry. In some places it is eaten dipped in fresh coconut milk mixed with sugar.
